# netbox_vpn_tunnel (Resource)

An encrypted or virtual tunnel (vpn.tunnel).

From the [official documentation](https://docs.netbox.dev/en/stable/features/vpn-tunnels/):

> NetBox can model private tunnels formed among virtual termination points across your network. Typical tunnel implementations include GRE, IP-in-IP, and IPSec. A tunnel may be terminated to two or more device or virtual machine interfaces. For convenient organization, tunnels may be assigned to user-defined groups.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "netbox_vpn_tunnel_group" "test" {
  name = "test-vpn-tunnel-group"
}

resource "netbox_tenant" "test" {
  name = "test-tenant"
}

resource "netbox_vpn_tunnel" "test" {
  name                = "test-vpn-tunnel"
  encapsulation       = "gre"
  status              = "active"
  vpn_tunnel_group_id = netbox_vpn_tunnel_group.test.id
  tenant_id           = netbox_tenant.test.id
  tunnel_id           = 42
  description         = "test-description"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `encapsulation` (String) Tunnel encapsulation protocol. One of: ipsec-transport, ipsec-tunnel, ip-ip, gre, wireguard, openvpn, l2tp, pptp.
- `name` (String)

### Optional

- `comments` (String)
- `custom_fields` (Map of String) Custom field values by field name. Every value is a string; NetBox coerces numbers and booleans. A key removed from the map is cleared in NetBox (set {} to clear all).
- `description` (String)
- `ipsec_profile_id` (Number) Id of the IPsec profile.
- `owner_id` (Number) Id of the owner the object is assigned to.
- `status` (String) Operational status. One of: planned, active, disabled.
- `tags` (Set of String) Slugs of the tags assigned to the object (the provider's default_tags are added on top, see tags_all).
- `tenant_id` (Number) Id of the tenant.
- `tunnel_group_id` (Number, Deprecated) Deprecated alias of vpn_tunnel_group_id.
- `tunnel_id` (Number) Numeric tunnel identifier on the wire (e.g. a GRE key), not the NetBox id.
- `vpn_tunnel_group_id` (Number) Id of the tunnel group.

### Read-Only

- `created` (String)
- `id` (Number) NetBox id.
- `last_updated` (String)
- `tags_all` (Set of String) Slugs of all tags on the object, including the provider's default_tags.
- `termination_count` (Number) Number of terminations of the tunnel.
- `url` (String)

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `id` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = netbox_vpn_tunnel.test
  id = "123"
}
```

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import netbox_vpn_tunnel.test 123
```
